categories.title: Plan operations & compliance workflows
categories.role: Health-plan operational controls and compliance workflows
categories.description: Supports regulated plan operations, case management, reporting and process controls. Software helps administer obligations; it does not replace legal review or regulator approval.
categories.buyer: Payer operations, clinical administration and compliance teams

categories.title: Home equipment & infusion
categories.role: Home medical equipment and infusion services
categories.description: Supplies home-use medical equipment or provides infusion care outside the hospital. Equipment distribution and administering treatment are separate services.
categories.buyer: Patients, prescribers, discharge teams and health plans

categories.title: Hospital pharmacy & medication systems
categories.description: Supports pharmacy dispensing, inventory and medication workflows in healthcare facilities. Hardware automation and clinical software play complementary roles.
categories.buyer: Hospital pharmacy, nursing and medication-safety teams

categories.title: Remote monitoring & chronic care
categories.role: Remote patient monitoring and longitudinal care
categories.description: Combines patient-generated measurements, virtual workflows and care-team support between visits. Some offerings provide technology, others also supply clinical services.
categories.buyer: Health systems, medical groups and home-care organizations

categories.title: Rehabilitation & specialty workflows
categories.description: Provides specialty documentation, care-planning, practice operations and billing tools tailored to rehabilitation and related care settings.
categories.buyer: Therapy practices, rehabilitation teams and specialty providers

categories.title: Clinical research & trial operations
categories.description: Supports trial management, research data and site operations. Research oversight services, clinical software and real-world evidence are different capabilities.
categories.buyer: Research sites, academic centers and clinical trial teams

categories.title: Referrals, transitions & home ordering
categories.description: Connects referring teams with downstream care, records and equipment suppliers. Referral orchestration is separate from the provider that delivers the service.
categories.buyer: Discharge planners, referral teams and home-care partners

categories.title: Implementation & managed IT services
categories.description: Helps organizations implement, optimize and operate clinical systems, data infrastructure and related technology. These firms are not themselves EHR products.
categories.buyer: Provider CIOs, transformation teams and technology leaders
